Class GooglyEyeItemRenderer

java.lang.Object
com.github.crittscott.somegoogly.client.render.GooglyEyeItemRenderer
All Implemented Interfaces:
net.minecraft.client.renderer.special.SpecialModelRenderer<GooglyEyeItemRenderer.Frame>
public class GooglyEyeItemRenderer extends Object implements net.minecraft.client.renderer.special.SpecialModelRenderer<GooglyEyeItemRenderer.Frame>
Renders a googly_eye item as the actual 3D ModelGooglyEye, tinted by the item's AppearanceOverride. Reuses the in-world eye model so the item and the mob eyes can't drift.

First- and third-person hand views select one holder/hand presentation, whose hurt and heal reactions the server sends to the holder and other viewers. Framed eyes have independent mounted pupil physics and ambient expressions, supplied by the frame's extracted render state. GUI presentations have their own clock, and ground views are static.

Registered as the somegoogly:googly_eye special model type and selected by assets/somegoogly/items/googly_eye.json; each loader puts GooglyEyeItemRenderer.Unbaked.MAP_CODEC under ID.

Draws through GooglyEyeRenderer.drawEye(PoseStack, SubmitNodeCollector, int, int, float[], float[], float, float, float, boolean), so the item and the mob eyes share one drawing path, texture, and pair of render types.
